name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Snatch
steps: Stand behind the bell with your feet just wider than your shoulders and hinge to grasp its handle with one hand.
Hike the kettlebell high between your thighs, then snap your hips explosively forward to launch the bell upward close to your body.
Guide the rising bell close to your chest and slide your hand through the handle to finish with a straight arm overhead.
Lower the bell to your shoulder, hinge into the backswing and guide it to the floor before switching arms.
tips: Time the upward punch early so the kettlebell rolls smoothly onto the back of your forearm instead of slapping it.
Power the lift with a sharp hip snap rather than trying to heave the bell up with your shoulder.
